title: FatterDex
tagline: A Pokedex that fills itself in from my real save files.
what: A website that tracks my living dex, Pokemon slang for owning one of every species, by reading the save files from every game I play.
built: Reads the save files directly, so nothing gets typed in by hand
Finds new save files on its own
Tracks every box and every shiny across games

making.problem: A living dex means one of every Pokemon, spread across a dozen games and save files. Tracking that by hand in a spreadsheet goes stale the minute you play.
how: It watches the folders where my save files land.
Each save is opened and read directly, box by box.
The website adds it all up into one dex across every game.

proof.caption: The living dex when I took this: 534 of 1,078 caught, box by box.
